description: The wire rules every reader enforces before a byte is written: bundle and release ids are [A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}, a hash is 64 lowercase hex, a manifest path is relative and /-separated with no empty, . or .. segment, no backslash and no NUL, timestamps are UTC with a Z, and every field of the shape is present, a nullable one as null. A refused index is INVALID_INDEX, a refused manifest VERIFICATION_FAILED, the whole document refused for one breach; an unknown field is ignored and an unknown condition type parses.

acceptedIndexes.name: should accept the index as the materializer writes it
should accept ids of one and of 64 characters drawn from the whole alphabet
should accept a field it does not know, on the index and on a release
should accept a condition type it does not know, which fails closed when evaluated
should accept a timestamp without fractional seconds
should accept the directive with its signature and a capped channel

refusedIndexes.name: should refuse a release id with a slash
should refuse a release id of 65 characters
should refuse an empty release id
should refuse a release id with a trailing newline
should refuse a release id with a letter outside ASCII
should refuse a release id that is a number
should refuse a bundle id with a slash
should refuse a bundle id with a dot
should refuse a bundle id of 65 characters
should refuse a revoked release id with a space
should refuse a manifest hash in uppercase hex
should refuse a manifest hash of 63 characters
should refuse a manifest hash that is not hex
should refuse a release without isMandatory
should refuse a release without rollout
should refuse a release without sizeBytes
should refuse a release without conditions
should refuse a release without notes, which is null when there are none
should refuse an index without isPaused
should refuse an index without revokedReleaseIds
should refuse an index without cappedAt, which is null when uncapped
should refuse an index without rollBackToEmbedded, which is null when there is none
should refuse a directive without signature, which is null when unsigned
should refuse isMandatory as a string
should refuse a fractional rollout
should refuse a rollout above 100
should refuse a negative size
should refuse a timestamp with an offset instead of Z
should refuse a platform other than ios and android
should refuse another schema major
should refuse a known condition type without its fields

acceptedManifests.name: should accept the manifest as the CLI writes it
should accept path segments that only contain dots
should accept a path with spaces and letters outside ASCII
should accept a field it does not know, on the manifest and on a file
should accept a manifest without deltas or patches entries

should refuse a bundle id of 65 characters
should refuse a delta base bundle id with a slash
should refuse an empty path
should refuse an absolute path
should refuse a path with an empty segment
should refuse a path with a trailing slash
should refuse a path that starts with a dot segment
should refuse a path with a dot segment inside
should refuse a path that is a dot-dot segment
should refuse a path that climbs out of the bundle
should refuse a path that climbs out from inside
should refuse a dot-dot segment followed by a combining mark
should refuse a path with a backslash
should refuse a path with a NUL
should refuse a file hash in uppercase hex
should refuse a file hash of 65 characters
should refuse a file without sizeBytes
should refuse a pack without sizeBytes
